question_text: In which option is the 'M' shape perfectly hidden?

options.label: A
options.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100'><rect x='20' y='20' width='60' height='60' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='4'/></svg>

options.label: B
options.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100'><circle cx='50' cy='50' r='40' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='4'/></svg>

options.label: C
options.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100'><polygon points='20,80 50,20 80,80' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='4'/><line x1='50' y1='20' x2='50' y2='60' stroke='black' stroke-width='4'/></svg>

explanation: The target shape is a capital 'M'. Option C displays a triangle with a central vertical line dropped from its top apex. The two outer diagonal legs of the triangle form the outer stems of the 'M', and the central vertical line combined with the apex creates the inner 'V' of the 'M'. Tracing from bottom-left up the left diagonal to the apex, down the center line, back up to the apex, and down the right diagonal perfectly reproduces the zigzag geometry of the target 'M'.
